# Claude Debussy — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Claude Debussy known for?", "Clair de lune"),
    ("What field did Claude Debussy work in?", "Impressionist"),
    ("What is lived?", "1862-1918"),
    ("What is field?", "Impressionist"),
    ("What is known for?", "Clair de lune"),
    ("What is note?", "Painting in sound"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
